title: One simulated work step
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean multi-tape Turing machine, let $x,v$ be Boolean words, and let $o$ be an oracle. Suppose a configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $v$ has state $s$. For every natural number $i$ and Boolean $\ell$, one step of the compiled oracle program from the image of $c$ with counter value $i$ and phase $(\mathrm{work}(c\text{'s scanned input symbol},\ell))$ equals the image of the one-step successor of $c$, with counter value $i$ and phase determined by the transition's input-head movement and by whether the scanned input symbol is absent and $\ell$ is false.
